nodes.id: docs_p0用户页安全交互闭环实施计划_l1l2l3precheck
nodes.label: L1/L2/L3 Safety Precheck
nodes.source_file: docs/P0用户页安全交互闭环实施计划.md
nodes.description: Three-level safety precheck system: L1 instant safety (limits, estop), L2 motion planning with FSTATUS/singularity detection, L3 process-level precheck (sequence validity, collision). Currently runs all three serially without short-circuit on failure.

nodes.label: Seven-Category Dashboard
nodes.source_file: docs/P0用户页安全交互闭环实施计划.md
nodes.description: Dashboard with seven categories: device_status, action_feasibility, safety_boundary, motion_limits, process_preview, process_adaptation, communication_faults. Provides real-time system state overview.

nodes.label: Emergency Channel
nodes.source_file: docs/P0用户页安全交互闭环实施计划.md
nodes.description: Three-segment encoding 'estop XXX estop' emergency command channel. Whitelist-based authorization, independent of NLP pipeline. Ensures emergency commands bypass normal voice processing for minimal latency.

nodes.source_file: docs/P0用户页安全交互闭环实施计划.md
